name: Itero del Castillo (Spain)
description: Square white flag with a yellow triangle issuing from the upper edge, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Itero del Castillo (a bridge and a castle above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Itero del Castillo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle from the upper corners pointing down
Itero del Castillo arms — bridge and castle above waves
